sloka: तस्मिन् हते ब्राह्मणदेवशत्रौ महाबले संयति कुम्भकर्णे।चचाल भूर्भूमिधराश्च सर्वे हर्षाच्च देवास्तुमुलं प्रणेदुः ।। ६.६७.१६२ ।।
transliteration: tasmin hate brāhmaṇadevaśatrau mahābale saṁyati kumbhakarṇe।cacāla bhūrbhūmidharāśca sarve harṣācca devāstumulaṁ praṇeduḥ ।। 6.67.162 ।।

translations.english: Then Rama yoking his bow with an arrow charged with Indra's mantra and decked with gold severed Kumbhakarna's arm which was like coils of serpent and held the palmyra tree.
